annotations.title: Buy a 30-day Route Pass ($3, up to 1,500 calls)

description: One x402 payment of $3 returns a pass token that unlocks route_task, seller_benchmark and market_map for 30 days (up to 1,500 successful calls). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["arbiter/pass"]. PAID: $3.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/month.
name: buy_route_pass_month
